sources.title: facebook/regnet-y-320 — AICHINA.news | AI China News
sources.snippet: RegNet-Y-320 is a convolutional neural network architecture for image classification, originally developed by Facebook AI Research as part of the RegNet family. It is hosted on Modelers.cn primarily as a reference model for the Huawei/Ascend ecosystem, allowing developers to run a standard ImageNet-classifier on Ascend NPUs.

sources.title: Boost Your Vision Pipeline: Meta's SEER-Pretrained RegNet-Y 320M ...
sources.snippet: What is the RegNet-Y 320M? This is a 320-million-parameter model from Meta (Facebook) built on the RegNet-Y architecture. It is designed to be a highly accurate, self-supervised pretrained image classification model.
